title: Chapter 52 Looking For A Daughter
content:
Chapter 52 Looking For A Daughter

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked back at the passage.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng stretched out his palm, and a powerful force forcibly refined the Hongmeng Universe on the other side of the passage.

This passage cannot be destroyed. If it is destroyed, the creatures in the Hongmeng Universe will really have no future.

But staying here is too dangerous for the Hongmeng Universe.

So the best way is to take control of it yourself.

After a while, the entire Hongmeng Universe was completely refined in Lu Daosheng's palm, and he had become the supreme existence of the Hongmeng Universe.

Just like the way of heaven.

Then, Lu Daosheng moved his mind, and the sound of the great way suddenly sounded in the Hongmeng Universe.

"All the creatures in the Hongmeng Universe, who have reached the realm of reincarnation, can ascend."

For a time, the entire Hongmeng Universe directly boiled up

Countless creatures screamed excitedly.

Ascend!

And in the Tianxuan world, at the site of the old deserted city.

Although the deserted city is gone, the countless treasures in the deserted city have improved the environment here. Even without the deserted city, this place is still one of the best holy places for cultivation in the entire universe.

Hearing this news, everyone began to practice hard.

Those who did not choose to go to another world with the deserted city did not want to go, but they still had ties here.

But they did not go there for the rest of their lives.

So, the entire Hongmeng universe completely entered the era of great cultivation.

All living beings are constantly working hard to enter the realm of reincarnation.

And in the Wanling Realm, under the urging of Lu Daosheng, the cultivation environment in the entire Hongmeng universe began to improve continuously.

He believed that in the near future, the Hongmeng universe would definitely be full of talents.

After doing these things, Lu Daosheng breathed a sigh of relief, but his expression was still not relaxed.

Because he had not sensed the breath of his daughter until now.

After pondering for a moment, Lu Daosheng felt more and more wrong.

His daughter did have many ungraded treasures that he had given her, so it was very easy to isolate her own aura. Besides, he was only in the Heavenly Fate Realm, so it was normal that he could not sense it.

However, if his daughter was fine, why did she block her own aura?

Something must have happened.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng looked a little ugly.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng directly used his great magical power to start deducing on the spot.

Suddenly, the name of a city appeared in Lu Daosheng's mind.

Sky Eagle City.

There, there was the aura of his daughter.

Looking at the deserted city in his hand, Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and a breath isolated the entire deserted city.

Finally, Lu Daosheng threw the deserted city directly on the former site of the evil demon clan, and then went to the direction of the Sky Eagle City.

Now, his daughter is the most important.

When I have time, I will change the place of the deserted city.

At the same time, the news that the entire evil demon clan was destroyed also began to spread rapidly.

The disappearance of such a large race would definitely attract attention.

After all, although the evil demon clan is not a top clan, it is not weak either.

It was suddenly exterminated without anyone noticing, which is terrifying.

And in Tianying City.

On this day, a terrifying aura suddenly descended on the city.

It was Lu Daosheng.

Looking around the city, countless creatures looked at Lu Daosheng in horror.

This aura, is this the legendary strong man in the heavenly realm?

Moreover, he is actually a human!

A sense of shock immediately washed over the hearts of all living creatures.

But Lu Daosheng looked directly at the old man in a teahouse.

There was a trace of his daughter's aura on the old man.

Then, in the eyes of everyone's surprise, Lu Daosheng walked directly to the human old man.

"Senior, what can I do for you?"

When the old man saw Lu Daosheng walking towards him, he immediately stood up and said respectfully.

At this moment, he was surprised and happy. The human race actually had such a strong person. The legend was not a lie.

Their human race really had a glorious history.

At this time, a picture appeared in Lu Daosheng's hand, on which was the portrait of his daughter Lu Xue.

"Have you seen this woman?"

Lu Daosheng said in a deep voice.

Seeing this picture, the old man was stunned.

"It's her!"

The old man was a little surprised.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng looked excited, "Tell me where she is?"

Hearing this, the old man was shocked and said: "Senior, I only met her once, and then she went with the Lord of Tianying City."

Of course, there was another sentence he didn't say. At this time, this woman was wanted by the entire Phoenix Clan.

This is not a secret. When Lu Daosheng arrives at the Lord of the City, the Lord of the City will tell him.

The old man lowered his head tightly, obviously because of nervousness.

There was no way. Lu Daosheng's aura was too strong. All the creatures around him stayed away from him. They didn't dare to get close to him, let alone say a word.

Hearing that his daughter had left with the Lord of Sky Eagle City, Lu Daosheng didn't hesitate. He flashed and went directly to the Lord's Mansion.

"Where is the Lord of Sky Eagle City?"

As soon as the words fell, Ying Chi appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Senior, I am the Lord of Sky Eagle City."

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Ying Chi immediately said respectfully.

When Lu Daosheng just landed in Sky Eagle City, he knew it.

But he didn't come out because he didn't dare.

This is a strong man in the sky realm.

And who knows what level of Heaven Realm he is? He only knows that even the most rubbish Heaven Realm expert can rub him with one hand.

Looking at Ying Chi in front of him, Lu Daosheng directly took out Lu Xue's portrait.

"Tell me, where is this woman now?"

Seeing Lu Xue's portrait, Ying Chi's pupils shrank slightly.

This change was naturally seen by Lu Daosheng.

Suddenly, a terrifying pressure directly crushed Ying Chi.

"I'll give you three breaths of time, tell me the truth immediately, otherwise, don't blame me for killing."

Lu Daosheng said coldly.

Feeling the terrifying pressure, Ying Chi's heart was like a storm. He had seen a Heaven Realm expert and felt the pressure of a Heaven Realm expert.

But compared with this pressure at the moment, it was just like a firefly compared to the bright moon, far away.

This is a strong man above the Heaven Realm!

Ying Chi did not dare to be careless and hurriedly said: "Senior, she went to Fengyu with a member of the Feng clan a hundred years ago."

"Fengyu?"

Lu Daosheng murmured, and was about to leave.

At this time, Ying Chi hesitated a little, and seeing this, Lu Daosheng frowned.

"What else, keep talking."

Seeing this, Ying Chi sighed in his heart, the Feng clan had this disaster in their lives.

Then Ying Chi said respectfully: "Senior, the woman you are looking for was wanted by the entire Feng clan not long after arriving in Fengyu, and the one who issued the wanted order was the Supreme Elder of the Ice Phoenix Clan."

"So far, there has been no news of her in the past hundred years."

After saying this, Ying Chi lowered his head and dared not say a word.

If he still didn't know the identity of the person in front of him and Lu Xue, then he would not have to be the city lord.

He knew that it must be a close relative.

At this time, after hearing this, Lu Daosheng was completely stunned.

The next moment, a terrifying murderous intent suddenly surged out of Lu Daosheng's body, and in an instant, the sky above the entire Sky Eagle City turned blood red.

Countless creatures looked at the direction of Sky Eagle City in horror.

Such a terrifying murderous intent, what on earth is that? !

In the Sky Eagle City Lord's Mansion.

Ying Chi just lay on the ground, holding his head and trying to keep himself awake.

However, this murderous intent was too strong. Ying Chi had a splitting headache at this moment, his eyes were red, and he kept praying for something.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already soared into the sky.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng no longer suppressed himself.

The terrifying aura of the Heavenly Fate Realm continued to tilt down, and all the creatures in the entire Sky Eagle City lost consciousness in an instant.

In the void, Lu Daosheng stared at the direction of the Phoenix Domain, with murderous intent in his eyes.

"Phoenix Clan, dare to arrest my daughter, if I don't avenge this, I, Lu Daosheng, am not worthy of being a father!!!"
